steps.npc: Not bad. I won't lie though, the stuff you told me about elves and dark lords is all a bit frightening.

steps.player: I know. I'm working on it though, by the time I'm done we'll never have to worry about any of this again.

steps.npc: I hope you're right. Be careful out there, I worry about you.

steps.player: I'll be fine Elena, don't you worry.

options.text: Do you have another sieve? I lost the last one.

steps.npc: Well it just so happens that by freak accident, I had hundreds delivered the other day!

steps.text: Elena hands you a large sieve.

after-song-of-the-elves.npc: Great! I've learnt so much from the Meilyr elves here. Their ways of doing things are unlike anything I've seen before.
And Prifddinas... The city is so beautiful. It's an honour to be the first human living here.

after-song-of-the-elves.player: That's fantastic! Anyway I won't keep you, see you later.
